title: Train and audit a policy from interaction

stages.title: Functional environment
stages.diagnosis: Inspect boundary moves, deadline priority and rewards after done.

stages.title: Batched trajectories
stages.evidence: Reconstructed episodes, axis diagram and key replay
stages.diagnosis: Check that active describes the state before the successful transition.

stages.title: Policy objectives
stages.evidence: Independent enumeration, finite differences and sampled gradient comparison
stages.diagnosis: Keep behavior log probabilities frozen and check both signs of the clipped objective.

stages.title: Training and held-out evaluation
stages.evidence: Multi-seed learning histories, baselines and per-agent held-out report
stages.diagnosis: Separate training keys from evaluation streams and preserve raw returns.

rubric: Enumerate transition and episode-ending contracts independently
Keep reset and final observations explicit
Collect actual randomized trajectories with reproducible independent keys
Derive the policy gradient and check it against an exact expectation
Keep old probabilities and targets frozen during clipped updates
Train multiple agents from fresh interaction
Evaluate with held-out streams and preserve per-agent variability
State the fixture limitations and diagnose one failed invariant
setupNote: Extract the project ZIP and work from its top folder, which contains requirements-cpu.txt and projects/policy-evaluation. A full checkout is optional.
